local.h: High tides speed up Palos Verdes landslide

local.h: Police brace for Halloween protests in France
local.b: Interior Minister Laurent Nunez warned of a 'very high risk of public disorder' on Oct. 31 and announced around 70,000 police for the Yellow Vest and student protests.
